title: Etiology Key-Pairs · Traceback — asbestos↔mesothelioma · lead↔disease · HPV↔cervix · crush then rip inside
thesis: Key-pair the agent to the phenotype for traceback — like asbestos↔mesothelioma, lead↔disease, HPV↔cervical cancer. The shared system is not one chemistry. It is a CRUSH POINT (contact / nucleation) on the outside face, then the RIP happens inside (cascade). Same Klein as monkey ZK: lock outside, damage-key inside.
not_medical_advice: Research / membrane-math face only. Not diagnosis or treatment.

answer_to_crush_question.q: If asbestos does that to the lungs, and cervical cancer can be viral — is the shared system cuts? Like a crush point between molecules causes a tear and then the rip happens inside?
answer_to_crush_question.a: YES on the geometry. NO on 'scissors cut DNA as the main asbestos story.' Shared form = nucleation at a contact crush-point → propagating failure INSIDE. Mechanism class differs by pair.
answer_to_crush_question.asbestos_nuance: Classic 'fiber mechanically tears mitosis' is largely ruled out. Biopersistent fibers → frustrated phagocytosis → ROS / necrosis → HMGB1 → inflammasome → chronic inflammation → surviving mesothelial cells accumulate mutations → mesothelioma. The crush is CONTACT + persistence; the rip is the INSIDE inflammatory/genomic cascade.
answer_to_crush_question.viral_nuance: HPV is necessary for nearly all cervical cancers. E6/E7 degrade p53/pRb — code injected at the crush (infection), rip = loss of checkpoints inside the cell lineage.
answer_to_crush_question.shared_form: OUTSIDE initiator seats at a locus → INSIDE cascade rips the system open. Traceback = pair the initiator to the phenotype, then walk the cascade backward.

traceback_method.rule: always pair AGENT ↔ PHENOTYPE, then walk crush → rip backward
steps: name the agent class (fiber / virus / metal / photon / toxin)
map inside cascade (inflammasome / oncoprotein / adduct / ion)
fit toxin math (log contact vs σ antitoxin window)
seat membrane analog (so ops can smell the same shape)
traceback_method.falsify: if agent removed and cascade still unique to another class → wrong pair
